dedupe_keys.name: india bias corrected expected and extreme cordex precipitation

description: This Figshare deposit provides bias-corrected CORDEX precipitation over India on a half-degree grid. Historical simulations cover 1961–2005 and projections extend from 2006 to 2100 under RCP2.6, RCP4.5 and RCP8.5, with available model combinations varying by scenario. NetCDF files include expected daily precipitation, a separately corrected extreme-precipitation product and quantile-mapping results. Downloads are free under CC-BY-4.0. The expected series can force continuous hydrological simulations for water supply, drainage or reservoirs. The extreme product supports conditional extreme-rainfall analysis and complements the expected series, but the paper explicitly warns that it assumes an extreme at each day and must not be used as an ordinary daily sequence. Copula-based bias correction depends on relationships learned from historical observations; those relationships may change in future climates. The grid also smooths local convective rainfall. Users must select the intended correction product and model-scenario combination before treating the files as consistent forcing.
